Amazon Monitron is no longer open to new customers. Existing customers can
continue to use the service as normal. For capabilities similar to Amazon
Monitron, see our [blog post](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/maintain-access-and-consider-alternatives-for-amazon-monitron "https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/machine-learning/maintain-access-and-consider-alternatives-for-amazon-monitron").

# Your AWS Monitron Device - Data generated by the use of the device

Your AWS Monitron collects data from the device and stores it in the Monitron Service.

**Types of Data:** Your Monitron device collects device data (such as username, IP address), measurement data (such as vibration and temperature data) and device telemetry (such as sensor and gateway logs).

**Data Volume & Collection:** The amount of data generated varies based on how you use your device and services. Data is collected once per hour during device operation.

**Data Storage:** Structured data from your device is stored securely on AWS servers. It is stored in machine readable formats.

**Data Access:** You can access your device data via the Monitron web application. You can also download a copy of your historical data at any time by requesting it via [Customer Support](data-download-monitron.md "data-download-monitron.md").

**Data Management:** You can manage your devices and settings and review your historical data via the Monitron dashboard. To learn more about your device's data practices, please review our [Service Terms](https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms "https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms") (section 81) and [Privacy Notice](https://aws.amazon.com/privacy "https://aws.amazon.com/privacy").

**Data Deletion:** You can delete your device data by deleting your Monitron project or deleting your AWS account. Instructions for deleting your Monitron Project can be found [here](mp-delete-project.md "mp-delete-project.md").

**Data sharing with others:** AWS does not share your device data with third parties. You can authorize third parties to access your AWS resources via our [Identify and Access Management](../../../IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.md "../../../IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_roles_common-scenarios_third-party.md") processes.

**Need Help?** Visit [Customer Support](https://aws.amazon.com/contact-us "https://aws.amazon.com/contact-us") to reach our support team. This is without prejudice to your right to lodge a complaint under applicable law.
